outcome: The demo runs against the Airwallex sandbox (never production) and its receipt proves three checkpoints from that run, each in mode sandbox with a provider id and reconciled by GET on that id: a genuinely new branch simulated in this run (not cached, created after the run started), the advance reconciled (Mode A a connected-account transfer, Mode B the simulated deposit carrying its simulation label), and the payroll payout reconciled as PAID (SENT does not count). Funding the sandbox wallet is setup, listed apart, and never counts. Measured from a receipt the sandbox run wrote, never counted from tasks closed or from a fake-transport receipt.
name: demo_checkpoints_live
unit: count of receipt checkpoints (0-3) in var/demo/live.json that are mode sandbox, carry a provider id and pass checks/demo_receipt.py --require-live; a missing receipt or a fake-mode receipt counts 0
source: bash scripts/demo.sh --mode sandbox --out var/demo/live.json (T23/T31) writes the untracked receipt; uv run python checks/demo_receipt.py var/demo/live.json --require-live validates it (exit 0 only at 3); bound to the goal by python3 checks/kpi.py g3 --print (T22, checks/goals/g3.py), which counts the sandbox checkpoints and prints the baseline 0 when the receipt is absent. Defined in prp/2026-10-20-ledgerworld/00-system.md section 17, row g3 (KPI demo_checkpoints_live, target 3).
observation: On the deployed environment's configuration with sandbox keys, run bash scripts/demo.sh --mode sandbox --out var/demo/live.json, then python3 checks/kpi.py g3 --print (or uv run python checks/demo_receipt.py var/demo/live.json --require-live directly) and read the printed count. A missing receipt, a fake-mode receipt, a cached or pre-run branch, an unreconciled advance, a payout only SENT, a mislabelled Mode B advance, a setup movement offered as a checkpoint, or a checkpoint without a provider id does not count. Record the checkpoint ids and run date in docs/airwallex-contract.md (T31); the receipt stays out of git. Observe after the sandbox credentials are granted, after every deploy, and before the build freeze (2026-11-12) and submission close (2026-11-13 18:29 UTC). Met when the value is 3.
evidence: Definition: 00-system.md section 17 (g3: KPI demo_checkpoints_live, target 3, sandbox checkpoints in var/demo/live.json: fresh branch, advance reconciled, payout reconciled) and section 10 (sandbox base only, production refused; Mode A/B leg mapping; Mode B receipts never described as lender disbursement; transfer PAID via simulation transition). briefs/T22.md: checks/goals/g3.py reads var/demo/live.json, counts checkpoints with mode sandbox, fake receipts count 0, baseline printed in a bare checkout (T22 writes the producer as --mode live; T31 and the execution HANDOFF name it --mode sandbox, which this record uses). briefs/T31.md: accept bash scripts/demo.sh --mode sandbox --out var/demo/live.json && uv run python checks/demo_receipt.py var/demo/live.json --require-live exits 0. design/modules/execution/HANDOFF.md and fixtures/demo-receipt.json: receipt shape, --require-live gives demo_checkpoints_live = 3, eight refusal cases (cached-branch, branch-before-run, advance-not-reconciled, payout-only-sent, mode-b-mislabelled, setup-counted, live-missing-provider-id -> 2), the valid fake receipt counts 0. Baseline observed 2026-10-27T04:37:47Z in this checkout at fa860e4: var/demo/live.json absent; scripts/demo.sh, checks/demo_receipt.py and checks/goals/ absent; python3 checks/kpi.py g3 --print -> no such file, exit 2. No sandbox receipt exists, so the count is 0. Sandbox credentials are not yet available to the deployed environment.
